content.summary: Three tasks after the scope change. T1 writes all acceptance tests (red). T2 (code length) and T3 (alias rule split) touch disjoint files and run in parallel in separate worktrees; each is compile-gated in isolation and the test stage proves the merged result.

tasks.title: Red acceptance tests: 8-char codes, alias minimum 6, legacy codes resolve
tasks.description: Update the ApiIntegrationTest code-length assertion; add GuessabilityIntegrationTest (AC-1..AC-3).

tasks.title: Raise the generated code length to 8
tasks.description: ShortenerProperties @DefaultValue and application.yml 7 -> 8, with a test pinning the bound value.

tasks.title: Alias minimum length 6 with a separate path-resolution rule
tasks.description: Split CUSTOM_ALIAS_REGEX (6-32, creation) from LinkRules.CODE_PATH (4-32, path templates); switch the controllers' templates; unit test.
tasks.acceptance: Compiles; legacy aliases resolve (proved by the test stage).

content.sequencingRationale: T2 and T3 share no files, so they fork separate worktrees and merge independently; the full suite runs once on the merged tree in the test stage.
